## Summary
Tracks whether RTP streams and layers are active, stopped, paused, and bitrate-available. The package provides generic stream tracker orchestration plus packet-count, frame-rate, and dependency-descriptor based tracker implementations.

## Responsibilities
- Define stream status and status-change contracts.
- Track stream activity using packet samples, frame markers, or dependency descriptors.
- Report per-temporal-layer bitrate and bitrate availability changes.
- Coordinate pause, reset, generation, worker, and callback behavior.
- Provide layered dependency-descriptor wrappers for spatial layer status and bitrate.
